notes: Clean puzzle. Each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, and the reviews state each clearly, so I had no doubts.
The dairy clue is a little soft ('nothing creamy in mine pls'), but Cyrus's cream cheese follow-up makes it clear. Hinoki Table is the intended near-miss and the reviews flag it.
Cedar Line's price clue is in both the card ($$) and the review ('a clear step up in price'), so you can't miss it.
Koi Counter's second review says 'still no milk'. The 'still' reads a bit oddly, as if it refers back to something earlier. Minor wording point.
Nothing unfair or contradictory found. It may be a bit easy for level 8, since every review spells out its constraint almost word for word.
